decisions.reason: The source specifically asks about the power-board production file; the independently specified sensor-board package remains unchanged.
Requiring a BOM and manufacturing exports for the power board does not change component availability or sourcing constraints.
The production-package contents do not alter connector pin labels or their placement.
The request for power-board production exports does not change interboard connector types, signals, pin ordering, or numbering.
The source changes documentation and manufacturing package contents, not battery-protection behavior.
The production-package request does not change the charge-status connector, indicators, or associated component values.
Including the BOM and manufacturing exports does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, or connector layout.
The source does not change the board-chain order, supplied rails, or power-forwarding behavior.
The production-package contents do not alter I2C cable, speed, pull-up, or series-resistor requirements.
The source concerns the power-board production package and does not modify main-board mechanical layout.
The power-board export request does not change the main board's connector inventory or architecture.
The source does not change the main board's power sources, OR-ing method, or source-selection behavior.
